_note: Topology layer over todo_roulette.json. Does NOT duplicate entry content — references IDs only. Bilateral: roulette runner reads this for block/gate logic; agents read it for session orientation.

ssot-chain.description: SSOT entity profile upgrade — sequential, each entry unlocks the next. Highest-leverage chain in queue.

cocos-build.description: Cocos Creator headless CLI axis — scaffold the project, then trigger the build. Writes manifest/cocos_build.json as the build-artifact axis of the Urca De Lima synthesis.
cocos-build.cli: bun run scripts/cocos_probe.ts build game/cocos-iso web-mobile

infra.description: Repo infrastructure, toolchain, debt — independently executable, no internal ordering constraint.

aai-birdcage.description: Project Birdcage AAI evidence lane — preserve failed/routed probes, provider surfaces, and budget gates as proof material rather than deleting failed POCs.
aai-birdcage.layers: birdcage/ + GitHub Copilot Chat/Claude 4.7 + GitHub Models + Foundry/Azure + HF/POE fallback lanes

lore.description: External lore + media asset investigation — low-weight, spin-decides.

dependency_chains.rule: Each entry is blocked until all prior entries carry status:completed. Do NOT spin into d4e5f6a7 or e5f6a7b8 while their predecessor is pending.

c0c05001 verify_condition (manifest/cocos_build.json) cannot pass until c0c05000 verify_condition (game/cocos-iso/package.json) passes. Scaffold before build. NOTE: Creator 3.x uses package.json as project file.

spin_semantics._note: Three behavioral classes. The roulette runner MUST respect blocked_until_chain before selecting a task.

urca_de_lima_synthesis._note: All four axes share manifest/todo_roulette.json as single data source. Four projection functions, one manifest.

axes.roulette: time axis   — task age/weight → Euler arc wheel (polar, todo_roulette.ts --live)
axes.dungeon: space axis  — room graph = task graph, adjacency=shared tags (main.rs --iso --dungeon)
axes.xp_trail: reward axis — Ω-3 write on room clear, Ω-4 HUD bar (.chthonic/xp-state.json)
axes.cocos_build: build axis  — headless Creator build → manifest/cocos_build.json → c0c05001 auto-clear
